prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied fox father and university-age son concept portrait. Preserve BOTH exact fox identities, facial features, grey-brown fur colors, age difference, proportions, single tails, composition, full body framing, neutral studio backdrop and high-end feature-film CGI rendering. Especially preserve the son's exact appealing swept tousled hairstyle, ears and confident half-smile.
Change clothing and refinement only.
LEFT FATHER: noticeably more affluent, distinguished and elegant, cultivated prosperous middle-class gentleman aged 50-55. Impeccably tailored deep espresso subtly textured wool three-piece suit, fitted waistcoat, ivory dress shirt, dark burgundy silk tie with restrained gold tie pin, neatly folded cream pocket square, fine gold-rim rectangular glasses, discreet gold wristwatch, polished oxblood leather Oxford shoes. Rich natural materials and beautiful tailoring, restrained quiet luxury. Replace scuffed folio with slim pristine dark leather document case held at his side. Slightly more composed dignified posture and intelligent authoritative gaze, keep recognizable face and grey temples. No royal costume, crown, cane, cigar or ostentatious piles of jewelry.
RIGHT SON: contemporary youthful HIP-HOP streetwear with a strong clear silhouette, still a 20-22 year old university student, NOT a child. Oversized deep charcoal varsity jacket with muted burgundy sleeves, worn open over a loose cream hoodie, hood down so hairstyle fully visible. Wide-leg faded dark indigo denim jeans with believable folds, stylish chunky cream and burgundy high-top sneakers. A single medium silver chain necklace and a small silver ear stud, tasteful street-style accessories; no face tattoos, no cap, no sunglasses. Remove old backpack and its straps completely. Keep smartphone held naturally in right paw, left paw casually in trouser pocket. Relaxed self-assured pose. No logos, lettering, symbols or brand marks.
Preserve natural articulated fur-covered paws and complete footwear touching ground, all ears and tails fully visible. Crisp individually resolved fur, woven wool, silk, denim and leather distinct physically based response, soft cinematic key light and subtle cool fill. No collage, no panels, no text, no watermark. Output landscape 3:2.
